entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Scoped constructor parameters should be able to reference top-level locals #80745
  • Use a canonical misc files project for misc files in VSCode #80743
  • Remove DOTNET_HOST_PATH workaround when updated images are available #80742
  • raw string lexing/parsing contains lots of duplication. #80731
  • Annoying IntelliSense behavior with multiply defined variables (18.3.0 Insiders [11109.51.main] but probably also 17.14) #80730
  • Brace completion exception in Code Analysis (Version: 18.3.0 Insiders [11114.75.main]) #80729

Closed

  • ambiguous between in `Add(TValue)` and `Add(params IEnumerable<TValue>)` #80512
    18.3
  • Extensions: known functionality bugs #78968
    18.3
  • Should documentation be updated with info about the RoslynDeployment project? #30267
    Backlog
  • When copilot fixes an issue, the tests it creates should have `[WorkItem("...")]` linking to the github issue #80736
  • 'nameof(Method)' should not appear in "Calls to 'Method'" in Call Hierarchy #71068
    Backlog
  • View Call Heirarchy shows nameof() operator as a reference and as recursive call #71351
    Backlog
  • Review VSTHRD003 suppressions #34287
    Backlog
  • Find All References shows NameOnly ref as Read #34236
    Backlog
  • Poor error recovery when declaring a pointer to an array type #33482
    Backlog
  • LINQ debugging is total crap #33459
    Backlog
  • Quick fix for ! nullable operator #33360
    Backlog
  • Switch Keyboard Language Layout Automatically #33334
    Backlog
  • Some existing 3rd party Roslyn analyzers are broken by C# 8 NRTs #33199
    Backlog
  • Capture a screenshot when the active window changes #33110
    Backlog
  • Resources.Designer.cs bug #32840
    Backlog
  • Rude edits do not appear in refactoring preview #32788
    Backlog
  • Can we modify `LocalRewritingValidator` to enforce that `BoundUnconvertedObjectCreation` does not survive past local rewriting? #57179
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Use a canonical misc files project for misc files in VSCode #80744
    VSCode
  • [release/dev17.8] Update Ubuntu and MacOS images #80741
  • Clean up code for converting collection expressions in the binder. #80740
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Add explicit logging when DOTNET_HOST_PATH is not found in BuildServerConnection #80739
  • Update repository to .NET 10 RC2 #80738
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Optimize ReadOnlySpan<T> initialization from `new T[constSize]` syntax #80734
  • Share certain raw string algorithms between lexer and parser. #80733
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • Add support for with(...) elements in collection expressions (3). #80568
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Extensions: fix betterness with params and issues with `this` modifier #80531
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • Add visualizer support for the StringBuilder class in VS #80735
    Area-IDE, Community, Next
  • Update docs for building runtime with local Roslyn #80725
    Area-Compilers, Documentation, Next
  • Update documentation for RoslynDeployment startup project and fix outdated references #80716
    Next
  • [release/dev18.0] Build BuildHost against net8.0 #80678
    Approved to merge
  • Revert "Go To Definition: Automatically navigate to user code when multiple locations include generated code" #80713
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Add LocalRewritingValidator check for BoundUnconvertedObjectCreationExpression #80724
    Next

Updated

  • Improve XML documentation clarity for IMethodSymbol.Arity property #80693
    Area-Compilers
  • Add XML documentation for GlobalStatementSyntax #80697
    Area-Compilers
  • Remove warning from 'in enum' extension methods #80708
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Fix SafeContext of Span-valued collection expressions to match specification #80684
    Area-Compilers
  • WIP #80623
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Make string concat assert more precise #80619
    Area-Compilers
  • Use single argument overload for `[start..]` of `string` or `(ReadOnly)Span` #74643
    Area-Compilers, Community, Code Gen Quality, untriaged, Backlog
  • [C#] Make interpolated strings including string or char constants as optimized as `+` operator (for string type) #72308
    Area-Compilers, Code Gen Quality, untriaged, Backlog
  • Extensions: Add ReduceExtensionMember API #80659
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Use built-in inline array types when possible #80557
    Area-Compilers, Code Gen Quality
  • Update documentation for DeclaringSyntaxReferences and Locations to clarify partial members behavior #80704
    Area-Compilers, Documentation, Test
  • Fix SyntaxFactory.Identifier to throw ArgumentNullException instead of NullReferenceException #80699
    Area-Compilers
  • Update code to use GetFirstLocation() instead of Locations[0] or Locations.First() #80709
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Avoid deep recursion in NullabilityRewriter.VisitBinaryPattern #80711
    Area-Compilers
  • Add regression test for EnC nullable attribute assertion during unmodified type completion #80657
  • Compute if a doc is generated code or not in OOP not on the host #80715
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Add regression test for ParseAttributeArgumentList with invalid input (fixes #8699) #80705
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve documentation and error message for InsertTokensBefore/After and ReplaceToken methods #80691
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve arity error message to prefer generic type when both generic and non-generic exist #80707
    Area-Compilers
  • Support null-conditional operator when the return value is a pointer type #80694
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve error messages for keywords used as identifiers in LINQ let clauses #80695
    Area-Compilers
  • Optimize CopyRefAssembly task by checking file size and timestamp before MVID extraction #80635
    Area-Compilers
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80654
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Support renaming files with nested type naming convention (Outer.Inner.cs) #80728
    VSCode
  • Add support for renaming nested types with Outer.Inner.cs file naming convention #80727
    VSCode
